key_insight: Stochastic transport connects uncertainty modelling in geophysical fluids with rigorous analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides a foundation for uncertainty-aware ocean forecasting and assimilation of observations into fluid models.
method: Establish well-posedness, regularity and approximation results using stochastic variational principles and rough-path methods.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures from observations and high-resolution simulations using reduced-order and generative models.
Develop Bayesian data assimilation through particle filters and machine-learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes theoretical and methodological developments but reports no datasets, quantitative benchmarks or forecast improvements.
watch_item: Practical deployment requires validation of calibration quality and computational scalability in high-dimensional geophysical systems.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
